purpose: Research comparison of stromal compartment masks, nucleus instances and cell identities

stroma.name: VISTA-PATH
limitations: stroma prediction does not establish tumor-associated eligibility
prompt-free inference still uses textual class prompts
box-prompted image and mask files must be joined by identity, never independent sorted order

nuclei.name: Cellpose 3
limitations: cyto3 cytoplasm model is not automatically a nuclei model
segmentation does not assign lymphocyte or plasma-cell identity
run on unmasked tissue with a halo, then intersect outputs with eligible stroma

classification.name: CytoFormer
classification.context: original unmasked RGB around nucleus centroid
limitations: predicted cell identities are not measured spatial IHC or gene expression
breast and lymph_node heads are separate
top-class probability is not calibrated confidence

research_endpoints.nuclear_area_proxy_percent: 100 * union of confident lymphocyte and plasma-cell nuclear pixels intersected with assessed eligible stroma / assessed eligible stromal pixels
research_endpoints.unknown_nuclear_area_percent_of_stroma: 100 * unknown or below-threshold nuclear pixels intersected with assessed eligible stroma / assessed eligible stromal pixels
research_endpoints.eligible_stroma: pathologist-approved tumor or residual-tumor-bed region intersected with total stromal compartment, including immune-occupied stroma, minus exclusions
research_endpoints.coverage_fraction: assessed eligible stromal area / all annotated eligible stromal area within the declared ROI
research_endpoints.unresolved_nuclear_area_rejection_denomi: all detected nuclear pixels inside assessed eligible stroma
research_endpoints.aggregation: sum areas before dividing; disjoint tile ownership required; never average models or unequal-stroma tile percentages
research_endpoints.exploratory_model_stroma_nuclear_area_pe: 100 * predicted lymphocyte and plasma-cell nuclear area in callable model-predicted stroma / callable model-predicted stromal area; no reviewed eligibility; not clinical sTIL
research_endpoints.competition_model_stroma_nuclear_area_pe: same exploratory area formula using the diagnostic maximum-probability stromal mask

validation.next_evidence: review artifact-aware sampling on annotated development tissue, followed by blinded stromal, nuclear and immune-identity references and independent patient evaluation
required_before_inference: review software and weight licenses for the intended operator and Modal transfer
hash all model and dependent assets
freeze preprocessing, prompts and sampling on development data
required_before_interpretation: select pretreatment or residual-disease scoring protocol
prespecify minimum stromal area, coverage and maximum unresolved nuclear area
validation.validated_claim: source-bound development artifacts and independently reconstructed area arithmetic; no accuracy or clinical validation

execution.storage: private Modal volume and ignored local private directory; no patient results in public repository
execution.sampling: 32 spatially distributed disjoint 1024-pixel native-resolution cores per source with 64-pixel halo; eligible tumor coverage unknown
execution.stroma_probability_comparison: preserve per-ROI Otsu/area-ordered mask and compare maximum independent class probability >=0.5; ties unassigned
execution.nuclei_preprocessing: hematoxylin optical density, 1st to 99.8th percentile scaling; assumed diameter 8 um, flow threshold 0.4, cellprob 0
execution.CytoFormer_preprocessing: original RGB 56 um context resized to 224 square with ImageNet normalization; breast or provisional lymph_node head
execution.segmentation_source_hash_gap: first segmentation batch omitted runner-source hash; settings, model assets and output hashes retained; current runner records source hash
